answer: Nora told me the ward was quiet.
variants: Nora told me that the ward was quiet.

answer: Ada said she had checked the alarm.
variants: Ada said that she had checked the alarm.
issues: 发言前已完成且题面限定本课倒移；一般过去时或现在完成时不满足该输出范围。

answer: Owen told me I was using his seat.
variants: Owen told me that I was using his seat.
issues: I指转述者；his指Owen。将I改成she虽可能描述同一女性，但违反明示I。

answer: Leo said the road was dry.
variants: Leo said that the road was dry.
issues: 与诊断frame主要仅替换说话者、对象和表语，不能据此单独证明新结构迁移。

answer: Iris said she was testing the radio.
variants: Iris said that she was testing the radio.

answer: They told me they did not want my photos.
variants: They told me that they did not want my photos.
They told me they didn’t want my photos.
They told me that they didn’t want my photos.
issues: they仅指编辑；my仅指转述者，不能改成their photos。

answer: Tara told me the gallery was closed.
variants: Tara told me that the gallery was closed.
issues: 咖啡馆是干扰记录；删除干扰后语法结构仍与frame诊断相同。

answer: Mira said she had not signed the form.
variants: Mira said that she had not signed the form.
Mira said she hadn’t signed the form.
Mira said that she hadn’t signed the form.
issues: 不得混入助手copying的记录；否定只作用于Mira签名。

answer: Ravi told me his sister was waiting for me.
variants: Ravi told me that his sister was waiting for me.
issues: his和me分别保留Ravi所有权与原听话者；不得将sister改成主语Ravi。

answer: Ben told us the hall was empty.
variants: Ben told us that the hall was empty.
issues: 与诊断frame只改变人物、听话者和场所/状态；told结构本身未变。

answer: Eve said she felt sick.
variants: Eve said that she felt sick.
issues: 本题从进行/完成时切换到一般过去时，不能机械照用上一题时态。

answer: Lia told me she was tired and she did not want my help.
variants: Lia told me that she was tired and she did not want my help.
Lia told me she was tired and that she did not want my help.
Lia told me that she was tired and that she did not want my help.
Lia told me she was tired and she didn’t want my help.
Lia told me that she was tired and she didn’t want my help.
Lia told me she was tired and that she didn’t want my help.
Lia told me that she was tired and that she didn’t want my help.
issues: 两个she都明确指Lia；第二项否定不能扩展到tired。自然的同主语省略she was tired and did not want my help符合情境，但题面明列两次she，故不列入限定variants。

answer: Zoe told us the bridge was unsafe.
variants: Zoe told us that the bridge was unsafe.
issues: 隧道安全不属于Zoe话语；句型仍是told + 听话者 + 状态从句。

answer: Nia said she had lost the key.
variants: Nia said that she had lost the key.
issues: 后来找回钥匙不改变她发言前的完成事件；不得添加找到钥匙的信息。

answer: They told me they had finished their work but I had not finished mine.
variants: They told me that they had finished their work but I had not finished mine.
They told me they had finished their work but that I had not finished mine.
They told me that they had finished their work but that I had not finished mine.
They told me they had finished their work but I hadn’t finished mine.
They told me that they had finished their work but I hadn’t finished mine.
They told me they had finished their work but that I hadn’t finished mine.
They told me that they had finished their work but that I hadn’t finished mine.
issues: 两个分句的主体不同，不能省略第二个I；mine指转述者的work，不能替成yours或their work。

answer: Uma said the lift was broken.
variants: Uma said that the lift was broken.
issues: 与guided-frame只换姓名、名词和表语；今早修复仅排除现况误读。

answer: Eli said he was carrying the box.
variants: Eli said that he was carrying the box.

answer: Max told us we were improving and he was proud of us.
variants: Max told us that we were improving and he was proud of us.
Max told us we were improving and that he was proud of us.
Max told us that we were improving and that he was proud of us.
issues: we指全队，he指Max；主体不同，第二主语不能省略；proud是状态，写was proud而非was being proud。

answer: Nora said she might cancel the trip.
variants: Nora said that she might cancel the trip.
issues: might保留未决定的可能性；would不能表达同样的不确定性。

answer: Leo told me he could not fix the lock.
variants: Leo told me that he could not fix the lock.
Leo told me he couldn’t fix the lock.
Leo told me that he couldn’t fix the lock.
issues: could not为过去记录的能力否定；would not误写成拒绝/将来安排。

answer: Ada said she would have to close the shop.
variants: Ada said that she would have to close the shop.
issues: 必须同时保留would与have to；would like to或could消除法规必要性。

answer: Ben said he might not publish the story.
variants: Ben said that he might not publish the story.
issues: 否定在可能性之内：可能不发表，不是禁止发表，也不是确定不会发表。

answer: Mia told me she could read the map.
variants: Mia told me that she could read the map.
issues: 与诊断ability同一倒移结构；肯否定改变需要核对，但词汇/人物改变不足以证明结构迁移。

answer: Owen said his assistant would not let him use the camera.
variants: Owen said that his assistant would not let him use the camera.
Owen said his assistant wouldn’t let him use the camera.
Owen said that his assistant wouldn’t let him use the camera.
issues: assistant是限制许可的人，him指Owen；不能写he would not use或let him to use。

answer: Ria said she might return.
variants: Ria said that she might return.
issues: 司机的will return是干扰；只替换人物/动作后的might从句仍复用诊断句型。

answer: Eli told me he could explain the warning.
variants: Eli told me that he could explain the warning.
issues: 能力声明不能被旁人的将来计划改写为would explain。

answer: Zoe told us she would test our machine the next day.
variants: Zoe told us that she would test our machine the next day.
issues: the next day相对星期一指星期二，不是转述当天星期三的明天；our保留机器归属。

answer: Nia said she might join the race.
variants: Nia said that she might join the race.
issues: 与诊断possibility只替换姓名及动作宾语，尚未引入新结构或新的可能性判断。

answer: They told me they could not understand the instructions.
variants: They told me that they could not understand the instructions.
They told me they couldn’t understand the instructions.
They told me that they couldn’t understand the instructions.
issues: 指不能理解，不是拒绝；与诊断ability主要仅更换主体数及动作对象。

answer: Ravi said he would not sell his camera.
variants: Ravi said that he would not sell his camera.
Ravi said he wouldn’t sell his camera.
Ravi said that he wouldn’t sell his camera.
issues: his指Ravi；否定为明确未来安排，不能替成might not。

answer: Uma said the result might be wrong.
variants: Uma said that the result might be wrong.
issues: wrong的可能性不能被另一人肯定正确的记录覆盖。

answer: Max told me he could not recognize the island.
variants: Max told me that he could not recognize the island.
Max told me he couldn’t recognize the island.
Max told me that he couldn’t recognize the island.
issues: 与诊断ability只改变人物和能力内容；不得以arrive/reach替换明示recognize。

answer: Tara said her team would have to wait but she would not wait.
variants: Tara said that her team would have to wait but she would not wait.
Tara said her team would have to wait but that she would not wait.
Tara said that her team would have to wait but that she would not wait.
Tara said her team would have to wait but she wouldn’t wait.
Tara said that her team would have to wait but she wouldn’t wait.
Tara said her team would have to wait but that she wouldn’t wait.
Tara said that her team would have to wait but that she wouldn’t wait.
issues: team不包括Tara；her team与she不同主语，不能省略she。have to的必要性仅属于team。

answer: Ash said he might lend the map but he might not lend the painting.
variants: Ash said that he might lend the map but he might not lend the painting.
Ash said he might lend the map but that he might not lend the painting.
Ash said that he might lend the map but that he might not lend the painting.
issues: 第二项是可能不借画，并非禁止。两个he均指Ash；同主语省略第二个he为自然表达，但题面明列but he，不列入限定variants。

answer: Eve told me she could play the tune but she could not read the music.
variants: Eve told me that she could play the tune but she could not read the music.
Eve told me she could play the tune but that she could not read the music.
Eve told me that she could play the tune but that she could not read the music.
Eve told me she could play the tune but she couldn’t read the music.
Eve told me that she could play the tune but she couldn’t read the music.
Eve told me she could play the tune but that she couldn’t read the music.
Eve told me that she could play the tune but that she couldn’t read the music.
issues: 两项技能的肯否定必须分开保留。省略第二个she在自然英文中成立，但题面明列but she，不列入限定variants。

answer: Noel told me he would bring my notes the next day.
variants: Noel told me that he would bring my notes the next day.
issues: 与independent-future共享would + 动作 + 所有权 + the next day，只改变人名/对象/参考日期。

answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will eat lunch indoors.
variants: We will eat lunch indoors if it rains tomorrow.
issues: 条件未实现，用rains；不使用表示意愿等其他if用法的will rain。

answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will not go to the lake.
variants: We will not go to the lake if it rains tomorrow.
If it rains tomorrow, we won’t go to the lake.
We won’t go to the lake if it rains tomorrow.
issues: 否定仅在结果；cannot将明确不去改成能力否定。

answer: She can enter the lab only if she gets a pass.
variants: Only if she gets a pass can she enter the lab.
issues: 唯一普通if答案不充分：只有拿到通行证才有许可严格给必要条件，而If she gets a pass, she can enter the lab表达充分条件。主答案保留情境逻辑；only if前置变体有倒装。二者均保留明示if、人物、词汇、现在时和can，并不承诺进入。若课程只收普通if…can，应补明拿到通行证即可获准；必要/充分两方向不可互作同义变体。

answer: If the bus is late, the driver will call.
variants: The driver will call if the bus is late.
issues: 与诊断future主要替换主体/状态及结果；be晚到与rain的形式不同，但条件逻辑不变。

answer: If we do not finish early, we will not join the party.
variants: We will not join the party if we do not finish early.
If we don’t finish early, we won’t join the party.
We won’t join the party if we don’t finish early.
issues: 两个否定均须保留；不能据此推出提前结束就一定参加。

answer: They can take photos only if the weather is clear.
variants: Only if the weather is clear can they take photos.
issues: 唯一普通if答案不充分：“只有…才”严格只是必要条件，If the weather is clear, they can take photos所需的充分条件可行性未明示。主答案保留必要条件，前置only if变体须倒装；若目标为普通if…can，建议说明转晴即可拍照。be clear表示天气已晴，可能弱化中文“转晴”的变化义，但符合明示词汇。

answer: If we receive the email, we will book a room.
variants: We will book a room if we receive the email.
issues: 仅报告收到邮件分支；不添加继续等待；条件未发生。

answer: If the power does not return, the exhibition will not open.
variants: The exhibition will not open if the power does not return.
If the power doesn’t return, the exhibition won’t open.
The exhibition won’t open if the power doesn’t return.
issues: 不能反推供电恢复则一定开放；only if/unless改写涉及必要/充分方向，不作为本题明示if词汇的变体。

answer: If he saves enough money, he can buy a computer.
variants: He can buy a computer if he saves enough money.
issues: can表示可行性；姐姐买手机不属于本句，will buy擅自作购买承诺。

answer: If ten people join, the teacher will start the class.
variants: The teacher will start the class if ten people join.
issues: ten people为复数，join不加s；与诊断future条件规则相同，人数/人物变化不能单独证明逻辑迁移。

answer: If Nia does not bring the key, she will not open the door.
variants: She will not open the door if Nia does not bring the key.
If Nia doesn’t bring the key, she won’t open the door.
She won’t open the door if Nia doesn’t bring the key.
issues: 中文“不能”原可表达能力不足，但题面明确限定未来不做；will not符合指定范围，cannot虽自然但不列入variants。

answer: If they finish the task early, they can rest.
variants: They can rest if they finish the task early.
issues: 资格不等于确定休息；与既有条件can句只改变主体与条件内容。

answer: If the rain stops, she will continue the match.
variants: She will continue the match if the rain stops.
issues: 只写雨停分支，不添加下雨等待，不把雨尚未停写成has stopped。

answer: If the new battery does not work, we will not use the old radio.
variants: We will not use the old radio if the new battery does not work.
If the new battery doesn’t work, we won’t use the old radio.
We won’t use the old radio if the new battery doesn’t work.
issues: 规则有些不常见但语言逻辑明确；不能凭常识把结果改成will use。

answer: She can use the instrument only if she completes the training.
variants: Only if she completes the training can she use the instrument.
issues: 唯一普通if答案不充分：“完成后才有许可”不严格保证完成即获许可，普通If she completes the training, she can use the instrument会额外给充分性。主答案及only if倒装变体保留必要条件；建议补明培训完成即可获准。she由题面指定，不另猜students的性别。

answer: If the alarm rings, the guard will check the room.
variants: The guard will check the room if the alarm rings.
issues: 应选alarm/ring；lamp/flash对应呼叫管理员。相较纯人名/对象替换，需真正选择触发条件。

answer: If he does not save the file, he will not send the report.
variants: He will not send the report if he does not save the file.
If he doesn’t save the file, he won’t send the report.
He won’t send the report if he doesn’t save the file.
issues: 没有保存⇒不会发送；不能推出保存⇒一定发送。与guided-negative同为否定条件和否定结果，词汇替换未改变逻辑结构。

answer: If the bridge reopens, we can reach the village.
variants: We can reach the village if the bridge reopens.
issues: 可达村庄不能改成will reach；港口的确定行程为干扰，不能混入。
